<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复远程工作区中待确认操作不显示的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">对话生成过程中也能正常搜索内容</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">命令输出过长时自动截断，避免界面卡顿</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复文件路径和引用显示错误、无法跳转的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复打开会话时滚动位置不正确的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">调整用户消息的显示宽度，长内容更易读</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">不再显示空的思考内容</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">不同任务的浏览器窗口相互独立，互不干扰</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">降低 Linux 大型工作区的文件监控资源占用</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复 Linux 系统安装后被旧快捷方式遮挡的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复定时任务删除结果提示不准确的问题</li>
</ul></article></div></div><div class="flex flex-col gap-6 border-b border-neutral-800 pb-16"><div class="flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4"><span class="w-fit rounded-full border border-white px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">3.10.2</span><span class="text-base text-foreground/50">发布于 2026年8月31日</span></div></div><div class="space-y-4"><h2 class="text-3xl">Release v3.10.2</h2><article class="space-y-4 text-base font-normal leading-relaxed text-foreground [&amp;_h1]:text-2xl [&amp;_h2]:text-xl [&amp;_h3]:text-lg [&amp;_p]:text-foreground [&amp;_ul]:list-disc [&amp;_ul]:space-y-2 [&amp;_ul]:pl-5 [&amp;_ol]:list-decimal [&amp;_ol]:space-y-2 [&amp;_ol]:pl-5 [&amp;_code]:rounded-md [&amp;_code]:bg-muted/40 [&amp;_code]:px-1.5 [&amp;_code]:py-0.5"><h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground">新功能</h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">新增 Weekend Plan 免费提前领取，可邀请好友一起来领</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">提示词模板引用的插件支持一键安装，进度提示更清晰</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">输入框菜单新增技能快捷入口</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">思考轨迹支持内容搜索，记录更完整并默认展开</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">MCP 服务器支持配置协议版本，协商失败时有引导提示</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">编辑后的消息支持立即发送，无需排队等待</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">对话回合结束时可查看执行摘要与耗时</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">设置中「浏览器」菜单更名为「浏览器控制」</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground">问题修复</h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">优化登录授权流程，修复偶发回调失败的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复偶现的 mcp oauth 失败问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">模型回复偶发中断或空白时，现在会自动重试</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复出错后排队消息丢失、中断任务状态显示错误的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">统一工具执行状态文案，思考过程标签更简洁清晰</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复任务操作提示被裁剪、触屏下任务信息错乱的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">打开任务时间线后未读标记会立即清除</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">提高长文本粘贴转附件的阈值，减少误转换</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复单个波浪线被误显示为删除线的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">切换侧边栏时输入框不再丢失焦点</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">输入框引用与命令菜单显示更清晰，搜索不再反复重试</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复工作区多个技能目录无法同时/列出的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复部分插件技能无法识别、名称显示不一致的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">用量统计默认展示近七天，图表与数值标注更清晰</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复 Windows 下后台进程退出后残留的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复Computer Use在 macOS 与远程工作区下的多处异常</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">提升浏览器控制会话稳定性，页面脚本执行更符合预期</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复移动端远程界面菜单超出屏幕的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复套餐过期后模型状态显示异常的问题</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">修复任务运行期间修改模型配置的报错问题</li>
</ul></article></div></div></div></section><div class="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col items-center gap-3 px-4 pb-12 pt-2 text-center sm:px-6 lg:px-10"><div class="h-1 w-full"
